name: implements Python iterator protocol and exhaustion
every saved list state resumes the correct suffix
input: states saved before each item and after exhaustion

name: validates states and snapshots input items
input: mutated caller list and invalid indexes

name: composite iterator restores child states
input: three child iterators with an empty middle iterator
test:
def drain(iterator):
    out = []
    while True:
        try:
            out.append(iterator.next())
        except StopIteration:
            return out

composite = CompositeIterator([ListIterator([1, 2]), ListIterator([]), ListIterator([3])])
assert composite.next() == 1
state = composite.get_state()
assert drain(composite) == [2, 3]
restored = CompositeIterator([ListIterator([1, 2]), ListIterator([]), ListIterator([3])])
restored.set_state(state)
assert drain(restored) == [2, 3]
